name: Recycling
description: The software project will develop a user-friendly web application that allows users to discover and manage recycling facilities. Key features include searching for nearby centers by zip code, viewing operational hours, accessing maps of recycling locations, and receiving notifications about events. Administrators will manage facility information and user feedback, ensuring data security while enabling communication between facility representatives and site admins to improve community recycling efforts.
rawDescription: The software project will develop a user-friendly web application that allows users to discover and manage recycling facilities. Key features include searching for nearby centers by zip code, viewing operational hours, accessing maps of recycling locations, and receiving notifications about events. Administrators will manage facility information and user feedback, ensuring data security while enabling communication between facility representatives and site admins to improve community recycling efforts.
highLevelGoals: Provide a seamless search experience for users to find recycling centers based on their location, supporting environmental responsibility and convenience.
Ensure users can access up-to-date operational hours and contact details to plan visits effectively and reduce unnecessary trips.
Deliver timely notifications about recycling events and provide interactive maps to enhance user participation and awareness.
Allow administrators to manage and verify facility information to maintain data integrity and support community recycling initiatives.
Provide administrators with tools to collect, categorize, and respond to user feedback to improve service quality and user satisfaction.
Establish a secure channel for facility representatives to report issues, request updates, or collaborate with admins to enhance recycling operations.
Implement robust security measures to protect sensitive user data and administrative communications, ensuring compliance with privacy regulations.
lowLevelGoals: User initiates a search query using their current GPS coordinates or manually entered address to retrieve nearby recycling facilities.
User clicks on a facility result to view detailed information such as operating hours, phone number, and website.
User subscribes to event notifications and receives alerts via push notification when events occur near their location.
User opens the map view for a selected facility and uses built-in navigation to get directions to the location.
Administrator reviews and approves or rejects facility data submitted by users or facility representatives.
Administrator updates facility operational hours, contact info, or status (e.g., closed, under maintenance) in the system.
User submits a feedback form or report detailing an issue (e.g., facility closed, incorrect info) via the app interface.
Administrator categorizes user feedback (e.g., operational, location, content) and assigns it to the appropriate team or individual.
Administrator responds to user feedback with a status update (e.g., 'Under review', 'Resolved') via the system interface.
Administrator initiates a secure message or collaboration request with a facility representative to resolve an issue or request updates.
Facility representative receives and responds to messages from administrators regarding facility operations or updates.
Administrator configures encryption settings and access controls for user data to ensure compliance with privacy regulations.
Administrator reviews logs of user data access and modification to ensure compliance and detect unauthorized activity.
Administrator assigns roles and permissions to users to restrict access to sensitive administrative functions.

baselineCritiques.actors: The actors defined are appropriate for the described software system. All relevant roles (User, Administrator, Facility Representative) are included without any omissions or contradictions. The names accurately reflect their responsibilities as per the description.
baselineCritiques.highLevelGoals: The high-level goals are well-defined, functional, and representative of the software's purpose. They cover all key aspects mentioned in the description, including user search functionality, operational information access, event notifications, administrative management, user feedback handling, communication between facility representatives and admins, and data security. No contradictions or omissions were detected.
baselineCritiques.lowLevelGoals: The low-level goals are well-aligned with the high-level goals and actors, covering all functional aspects of the software. However, there is a minor issue in the branching structure where "Enable efficient handling of user feedback and site-specific issues" appears under both [User] and [Administrator], which could be confusing. Additionally, while the low-level goals address most functionalities, they lack explicit mention of data validation or error handling for facility submissions (e.g., ensuring operational hours are correctly formatted). The security-related low-level goals are comprehensive but could benefit from specifying compliance with standards like GDPR or HIPAA if implied by the high-level goal.
